title: Carreras Pathfinders
html:
CarrerasPathfinders

„Victor Babes National Institute of Pathology is happy to announce the opening of the
Call for Applicants, within the frame of CarrerasPathfinders MSCA COFUND doctoral program, hosted at either the University of Barcelona (UB) or the Autonomous University of Barcelona (UAB) , through 14 doctoral programs, over a period of 48 months. 

Eligible PhD candidates should not have a doctoral degree at the date of their recruitment, must be entitled to enrol in a doctoral program, and should not have resided in Spain for more than 12 months in the last 3 years prior to the call deadline (March 1st, 2024).

All information concerning the application and selection processes, as well as the description of the 14 doctoral projects, can be found on the program’s website:
 https://carreraspathfinders.eu/about-the-program/ „
